name: Faded Theater
description:
Under the direction of an immortal musician, a certain ancient troupe once performed the elegies of an ancient civilization.
With the passage of time, the ancient plays became legend. Legend became myth. ...Until one day, by chance, it was deliberately picked up once more, and became the prelude to a new dream.

tabs.name: Domain of Blessing: Variation I
tabs.description:
The prophet and the ruler, heroes and fell dragons, the grand opera of the golden age once played out here.
Now, the only players left on the stage are monsters of unknown provenance. You shall earn priceless Artifacts, if — and only if — you can defeat them.
